description: Public operations the web console performs. The console, the Python SDK and the rlworld CLI each implement every one; parity tests hold all three to this list.

operations.name: save_spec
operations.summary: Save a spec and get its immutable digest

operations.name: get_spec
operations.summary: Read a saved spec

operations.name: preflight
operations.summary: Validate, estimate and warn before any budget is spent

operations.name: dry_run
operations.summary: Play one episode end to end and watch it live

operations.name: launch
operations.summary: Launch every sweep point as a run

operations.name: get_experiment
operations.summary: Read an experiment's budget, spend and runs

operations.name: approve_experiment
operations.summary: Approve a launch above the approval threshold

operations.name: list_runs
operations.summary: List runs, optionally of one experiment

operations.name: get_run
operations.summary: Read a run's state and operational settings

operations.name: get_run_spec
operations.summary: Read the full spec a run plays, to clone or reproduce it

operations.name: control_run
operations.summary: Pause, resume, stop or change concurrency, priority or budget

operations.name: run_events
operations.summary: Stream a run's events

operations.name: list_episodes
operations.summary: List a run's episodes, running or finished

operations.name: get_episode
operations.summary: Read an episode with its steps and reward

operations.name: live_wall
operations.summary: Sampled running episodes with their latest frame

operations.name: get_frame
operations.summary: A frame, as a thumbnail or at full resolution

operations.name: cohort
operations.summary: Finished episodes filtered for side by side scrubbing, with their filmstrips

operations.name: get_provenance
operations.summary: The checks, judge rationale, states and world diff behind a score

operations.name: get_step_prompt
operations.summary: The exact model input of one step

operations.name: review_episode
operations.summary: Flag, label, file a verifier bug, draft a task or add to an audit sample

operations.name: analyze_failures
operations.summary: Label and cluster a run's failures and file bug tickets

operations.name: get_failures
operations.summary: Failure clusters per template and policy version

operations.name: run_report
operations.summary: Success rates with confidence intervals per template and difficulty, pass at k

operations.name: compare_runs
operations.summary: Runs side by side on the tasks they share

operations.name: compare_policy_versions
operations.summary: Policy versions side by side on the same tasks

operations.name: list_review_items
operations.summary: Review items by queue, status, run or episode

operations.name: list_catalog
operations.summary: List images, worlds, task templates, verifiers, rubrics or endpoints

operations.name: list_endpoints
operations.summary: List registered policy and judge endpoints

operations.name: register_endpoint
operations.summary: Register a BYO policy or judge endpoint

operations.name: test_endpoint
operations.summary: Probe reachability, latency, token ids and logprobs

operations.name: set_endpoint_key
operations.summary: Store an endpoint key in the vault; keys are write only
